traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and requirements for 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG are satisfied. The plugin exposes recommended and strict flat-config presets, thoroughly tested with ESLint v9’s FlatESLint. Rule-level configuration options and customizable story paths are implemented via JSON Schema (with additionalProperties: false) and dedicated option-validation logic that gracefully handles invalid configurations with clear diagnostics and safe fallbacks. Documentation in README and user-docs (ESLint 9 Setup Guide, examples, migration guide) provides clear, flat-config-based setup instructions for JavaScript, TypeScript, mixed projects, and monorepos. All story-linked test suites pass, so this story is fully implemented and passes.
